# A program naming two targets builds both, each as a program of its own.
# `sngl build` and `sngl run` generate into a directory they own, and wrote
# every target into the same one: gtk4 leaves a callbacks.go declaring main, so
# the bubbletea build after it found two mains and a BuildUI of the wrong
# shape.

[!gtk4] skip 'needs the gtk4 development libraries'

sngl build -o bin app.sngl
[toolchain] exists bin/app-gtk4 bin/app-bubbletea

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        gtk4
        bubbletea
    }
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- testrun/build/bubbletea/go/app.sngl/1 --
sha256:bb7472a6e34e98d6dd8da1bf424932c7
{}
-- testrun/build/gtk4/go/app.sngl/1 --
sha256:abb576c850acb736f49e7ce43b55a3a5
{}
